title: The Mass Gap of Pure SU(N) Gauge Theory as a Finite-Aperture Effect
description:
The paper reads the mass gap of pure SU(N) Yang-Mills as a finite-aperture effect: the vacuum is read through a finite aperture, which band-limits, and the gap is the entropy margin Delta = kappa_0 - mu > 0 below the counting floor kappa_0 = (1/4) ln 3 -- a number COUNTED from directed cube paths, with no fitted constant. Pure Yang-Mills carries no dimensionful parameter, so a fitted constant anywhere below the gap would be a smuggled scale; the counted floor is what makes the transmutation legitimate.

THE FORMAL STATUS. Every theorem of the formal development is complete, and the axiom footprint of every theorem is machine-printed, so the line between what is proved and what is assumed can be read off the record.

THE RESULTS. Reflection positivity is PROVED at even lattice extent at least four and nonnegative coupling, by an action split and a three-block Haar factorisation with no representation theory, and cited outside that domain; on that domain the gap side of the finite-aperture model carries NO named axiom. The correlation's symmetry on the lag circle is proved, which grounds the circle-distance reading of the correlation. The substrate input of the finite-aperture route is reduced to a contact-relative power law on the plaquette correlation, and that law is proved OUTRIGHT on a derived strong-coupling interval, carrying no hypothesis; the weak-coupling remainder is open.

The repository holds the paper, the Lean 4 / Mathlib development, and the Entroptics analysis code.
